messages:
maria: hi all  day 1 and already a few quick logistic/questions so I don't ping the wrong people: who handles badge pickup, who approves repo and GPU requests, and who should I page if a model publish causes customer regressions? also where's the short "who-to-ping" cheat sheet i can keep in my notes?

ben: welcome maria! :wave: badge/physical access is handled by facilities. email facilities@redwood.com or DM me for a kiosk print (bring ID). you'll be added to group `redwood-building-access`.

cecilia: repo/GPU approvals go through eng-infra. best flow is to use the access helper in #eng-infra. snippet you can paste:```/access-request repo:redwood-inference/model-serving role:developer reason:"onboarding - needs commit"```
for GPU quota:```/infra-request resource:gpu-cluster-1 quota:1 reason:"dev/testing during onboarding"```
then tag @cecilia for review. paste the returned ID into your onboarding Jira ticket.

maria: great, thanks. who maintains the owners roster? i've seen a couple of copies.

ron: short truth: canonical owners list is the "service-ownership" doc in the handbook (pinned in #product). TL;DR map for quick reference: runtime -> eng-runtime, serving infra -> eng-infra, api/gateway -> eng-platform, observability -> eng-sre, ml infra/modelops -> eng-ml. i'll DM you a snapshot with names/handles.

maria: if a publish job completes but models are mismatched and users see stale responses, who gets paged first?

ron: page eng-runtime first (they own model serving/version routing). if indicators point to infra (OOMs, nodes), eng-infra joins. if user-facing errors spike, eng-sre + support@redwood.com as well. typical flow: triage in #eng-runtime -> escalate to oncall -> create incident if P1/P0.

cecilia: small tip: if you're running tests that might trigger alerts, use staging or disable paging during a dev window and DM the oncall. docs: https://internal.redwood/docs/alerting-guidelines

infra-bot: [auto] access request created: AR-6042 (repo:redwood-inference/model-serving)  requester: maria  reviewer: cecilia  status: pending.

hr-bot: [auto] reminder: complete SEC-101 security training within 5 business days to get full approvals.

maria: awesome, thank you everyone  i'll add AR-6042 to my onboarding Jira and watch for the badge email. appreciate the shortcuts and the owners snapshot, ron.

ben: ping me if kiosk doesn't print  i can escalate for same-day pickup. :thumbsup:

maria: will do, thanks all!
